metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Jumps and It's Set to Surpass Apple Again<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
What Nvidia and Apple’s Tug-of-War Says About the AI Trade
Nvidia and Apple traded places as the world’s largest company yet again on Tuesday, after the iPhone maker’s so-so revenue guidance weighed on its shares.
